full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white, soft-focus photograph shows bright sunbeams breaking through a group of trees beside still water, with their dark reflections filling the foreground. The upper half is a dense canopy of leaves and trunks, almost black at the outer corners. Near the top center-right, a bright gap burns through the foliage; diagonal shafts of light descend toward the lower right through visible mist. A cluster of upright trunks stands slightly left of center along a low shoreline, its roots and the bank reduced to one dark horizontal strip. Behind it, pale haze obscures the farther trees so their vertical shapes dissolve before reaching the water. The water begins around the middle of the frame and lies nearly level, reflecting the trunks, leaves, and bright sky in broken shapes. Below the central trees, long dark reflections extend downward, interrupted by small silver patches where the light catches slight ripples. The reflected bright opening forms a luminous area toward the lower center, but the lower corners remain very dark. The image has few discrete objects beyond trunks, foliage, shore, and water, so the pattern of light itself becomes the subject. Strong backlight creates nearly featureless silhouettes around the opening and soft rays through the moist air. The light scatters and loses definition as it crosses the water, where bright and dark patches interlace. Black edges and a naturally blurred softness give the scene the imperfect look of a simple analog-camera print. Fine grain is visible across the midtones, and some highlights bloom beyond sharp detail. No people or readable text appear. The overall composition is quiet and symmetrical in broad masses, with the bright central opening doubled by reflection and surrounded by deep woodland shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白柔焦照片呈现明亮日光束穿过静水旁的一组树木，深色倒影填满前景。上半部是密集枝叶与树干，外侧两角几乎全黑。靠近上方中央偏右，明亮开口穿透叶冠；斜向光束透过可见的薄雾落向右下。一簇直立树干位于中央稍左的低矮岸线边，其树根与河岸被收缩为一道暗色水平带。后方浅雾遮住更远处的树木，竖形在触及水面前便逐渐消散。水面从画面中部附近开始，几乎保持水平，以破碎形状映出树干、树叶和明亮天空。中央树木下方，长长的深色倒影向下伸展，被光落在轻微波纹上形成的小银色斑块打断。明亮开口的倒影在下部中央形成发光区域，但下方两角仍非常暗。除了树干、枝叶、岸和水，图像几乎没有离散物件，因此光的图案本身成为主体。强逆光使开口周围形成近乎无细节的剪影，并在潮湿空气中显出柔软光线。光越过水面便散开且失去明确边界，明暗色块互相交织。黑色边缘和自然模糊的柔软感使场景带有简易胶片相机冲印的不完美质感。中间灰区域可见细颗粒，一些高光泛开，超出锐利细节。没有人物或可读文字。整体构图在大形上安静而近乎对称，中央亮口被倒影再现，四周包着深沉林影。
style_prompt_en: The soft-focus monochrome photography uses dark vignetting, blooming highlights, and visible grain to turn ordinary forms into luminous silhouettes. Black gathers around the frame, while a concentrated pale opening sends soft diagonal rays through haze. Broad shapes remain readable despite blurred edges; fine detail gives way to tonal atmosphere near the brightest area. A horizontal dividing band allows bright and dark patterns above to repeat below in imperfect reflection. Small silver flecks break the heavy lower blacks without flattening their depth. Strong backlight hides surface color and much internal detail, making light direction and negative space the main structure. The overall effect is dreamlike, hushed, and tactile, with simple optics and imperfect focus producing a distinctive glow.
style_prompt_zh: 这种柔焦单色摄影利用暗角、泛开的高光和可见颗粒，把普通形体变为发亮剪影。黑色聚在画框周围，集中的浅色开口把柔和斜向光束送入雾气。尽管边缘模糊，大形仍清楚可读；最亮区域附近的细节让位给明暗氛围。一道水平分界使上方明暗图案在下方以不完美的倒影重复。小银色光点打断沉重的下方黑色，却不压平其深度。强逆光隐藏表面颜色和大量内部细节，让光的方向及负空间成为主要结构。整体效果如梦、寂静而可触，简单镜头效果与不完美对焦产生独特光晕。
theme_en: Sunbeams through trees reflected in still dark water
theme_zh: 树间日光束倒映在平静的深色水面
name: Holga photography
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
